pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, medium-brown polygonal patches exhibiting smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges, likely due to image resolution and motion blur. Flank patches are predominantly quadrilateral with rounded vertices.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of three-way intersections. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, widening at the base of the neck.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, low-frequency jagged profile is visible along the dorsal neck line, though individual hair-level resolution is not achieved due to pixel blur.
